cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a rooftop observatory deck at night — a domed telescope, folding stargazing mats, a lantern and a wide starry sky over the town
cuts.scene: she is a guide sitting on the deck mat gazing at the sky, ready to point out a shooting star
cuts.outfit: a stargazing guide look fitted to her body — a fitted star-print jacket over a halter top and short shorts, bare shoulders and legs, a small silver star necklace
